worst_flaw: The 30% team target counts tickets with no applicable article in the denominator and is not tied to how many tickets each queue could actually cover. That makes the goal arbitrary and possibly out of reach, and it can push agents toward weak links. Because only a few teams are randomised, the lunch-versus-feedback comparison has little statistical power, and the plan says nothing about uncertainty or how shared queues and agents could spill effects between rewarded and waiting teams.
